name: BAM

kernel_size.description: kernel size for dilated convolutions; default 3

dilation_val.description: dilation value for spatial branch; default 4

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, channel, reduction=16, kernel_size=3, dilation_val=4):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    eff = dilation_val * (kernel_size - 1) + 1
    min_size = min(h, w)
    if eff > min_size:
        if min_size <= 1:
            safe_dilation = 1
            safe_kernel = 1
        else:
            safe_dilation = min(dilation_val, min_size)
            safe_kernel = min(kernel_size, (min_size - 1) // safe_dilation + 1)
            if safe_kernel > 1 and safe_kernel % 2 == 0:
                safe_kernel -= 1
        kernel_size = safe_kernel
        dilation_val = safe_dilation

    mlp = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(channel, channel // reduction),
        nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        nn.Linear(channel // reduction, channel)
    ).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv1 = nn.Conv2d(channel, channel // reduction, kernel_size=1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv2 = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Conv2d(channel // reduction, channel // reduction,
                  kernel_size, padding=dilation_val, dilation=dilation_val),
        nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        nn.Conv2d(channel // reduction, channel // reduction,
                  kernel_size, padding=dilation_val, dilation=dilation_val),
        nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
    ).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv3 = nn.Conv2d(channel // reduction, 1, kernel_size=1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    y_ch = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1).view(b, c)
    y_ch = mlp(y_ch)
    y_ch = y_ch.view(b, c, 1, 1)
    channel_attn = y_ch.expand_as(x)

    y_sp = conv1(x)
    y_sp = conv2(y_sp)
    y_sp = conv3(y_sp)
    spatial_attn = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(y_sp, (h, w))
    spatial_attn = spatial_attn.expand_as(x)

    attn = torch.sigmoid(channel_attn + spatial_attn)
    out = x + x * attn
    return out
